purpose: Stack of decision cards for working through a review queue on a phone: drag a card to accept or reject it, or press the equal round buttons, with Undo, progress and an all-caught-up state.
useWhen: Working through a queue of items one at a time on a phone, where each item gets an accept, reject or later decision.
Offering a swipe as a shortcut for decisions that also have buttons and keys, with a visible Undo after each one.

avoidWhen.reason: Reviewing one pending tool call with its full detail and an audit trail.
Deciding many items at once from a table, where rows need sorting and bulk actions.

rationale: Nearest alternative: ApprovalCard — ApprovalCard resolves one request with its full detail; DecisionDeck moves through a whole queue of short cards.

keyboard.action: Accepts the focused top card, or rejects it right to left.
Rejects the focused top card, or accepts it right to left.
Sets the focused top card aside for later.

notes: Every swipe decision is also a labelled button and an arrow key, and each decision is announced and can be undone.
